title: Thai Fish Bowl Noodle Soup
description: A healthy and flavorful Thai-inspired noodle soup made with fish and nutritious vegetables.

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables (Bell Peppers, Carrots, Green Beans)

instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a separate pan, heat the Thai red curry paste over medium heat.
3. Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender.
4. Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
5. In a separate saucepan, combine the coconut milk, fish sauce, and syrup.
6. Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
7. Add the cooked noodles to the saucepan and toss to combine.
8. Add the cooked vegetables and fish to the saucepan and toss to combine.
9. Serve the soup in bowls and garnish with lime wedges.
